Seven Phase 1 payments of €3,490 total €24,430. This covers website delivery in months 1–4 and our full technical integration plus the first 20 SEO landing pages in months 5–7 after website approval. No extra pages or package selection is assumed. Confirm provider charges when systems are agreed. ROI means assessing paid purchases and recorded revenue against the baseline; no financial return is forecast.

Digital Movement · Elite Fit BaliProposed measurement plan · Establish the baseline before judging progress

This is the proposed measurement plan. We first establish what data can be captured reliably from the chosen systems, record the baseline, and test that a successful payment is counted accurately. Track completed paid pass and new membership purchases and their recorded value, where available; do not treat a button click or an abandoned checkout as a sale. Use a defined purchase completion rate and useful traffic sources to locate friction. Review manual follow-up with the club team. Tracking feasibility and attribution depend on system access and the agreed setup. Phase 2 includes monthly tracking, one priority improvement and a report. No analytics installation or improvement result is claimed, and we have not forecast financial ROI.

This is the commercial package summary, rebuilt from the latest proposal’s Build your package section. It is separate from the customer checkout demonstration on slide 6. Phase 1 is the same in every option: seven payments of €3,490, totalling €24,430, for the 12–15 core website pages with original copy, full integration and first 20 SEO landing pages. Phase 2 has five payments. Foundation adds 4 pages each month: 20 + 5 × 4 = 40 SEO pages; €24,430 + 5 × €1,490 = €31,880. Growth adds 10: 20 + 5 × 10 = 70; €24,430 + 5 × €1,990 = €34,380. Max adds 20: 20 + 5 × 20 = 120; €3,490 × 85% = €2,966.50 per month, and €24,430 + 5 × €2,966.50 = €39,262.50. The 15% Max discount applies only in months 8–12, saving €2,617.50 over those five months. The 12–15 core pages are additional to every SEO total. No extra pages or selected package are assumed. All options include monthly tracking, one priority improvement and a report.
